title: Oto-Manguean languages - Wikipedia
text: The Oto-Manguean or Otomanguean languages are a large family comprising several subfamilies of indigenous languages of the Americas.For Mazatec, some dialects have elaborate Sandhi systems (e.g. Soyaltepec) and others do not (e.g. Huautla Mazatec).
